title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Exchange Planner Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, focused adapter tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace core validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the local RFC 9464 exchange planner.
scope: This verification covers the local Configuration Payload value model and planner for CFG_REQUEST support advertisement, CFG_REPLY response selection, client plan creation, payload-type validation, non-request reply rejection, empty reply behavior after request discard, and fake-backed CFG_REQUEST/CFG_REPLY transport exchange. It does not verify live IKEv2, IPsec, resolver installation, or encrypted DNS session establishment.
preconditions: Existing RFC 9464 attribute codecs, responder policy, and client policy remain trace-owned.
The exchange planner is used only as a local deterministic model and not as a live IKEv2 transport claim.
expected_result: The DNS package builds, the exchange planner tests pass, the new requirement is trace-clean, generated triage remains fully clean, SpecTrace core validation passes, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: On 2026-06-16, the DNS package built in Release and the focused RFC 9464 exchange planner tests passed locally. This is deterministic local exchange-model evidence only; live IKEv2 and platform resolver work remain external adapter blockers.
